title: rest + sdk: tenant-admin door for the record-currency backfill — a REST twin of `os migrate record-currency-codes`, scoped to the caller's organization (multi-currency, epic #8345, ruling C item B)
body:
epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZWjnSeed8H4dMjt9d

Blocked-by: #30674

Part of #8345. Filed by the epic PM from ruling 6670707546 (letter C, maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-05T21:57Z), item B. ⛔ Not a claim.

Ruling-ref: 6670707546

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 给币种码回填开一个 REST 入口（仿已有的 `POST /meta/_migrate-stored`）：`{ object, field, code, apply? }`，只作用于调用者当前组织，默认预览，`apply: true` 才写，返回与 CLI 相同的报告；配 SDK 方法与路由台账行；409 `destructive_change` 的处方文案同时点名这个入口。
- **为什么改：** 云托管租户没有 shell，跑不了 CLI；本位币折算在 18.3.0 已上线，切了模式的云租户今天就在静默漏算。
- **风险与回滚：** 中低。新增一条路由，只写本组织，受维护开关控制。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts` 的 `_migrate-stored`。
- **两分钟验证：** 两个组织：A 的管理员调预览只看到 A 的行；`apply: true` 只写 A。
- **需要您做的：** 无（门禁按裁决推荐取 `setup.write`；如需改为 `manage_metadata` 请在卡上说）。

## Task

- [ ] One route shaped on `POST /meta/_migrate-stored`, taking `{ object, field, code, apply? }`, calling the A card's `backfillRecordCurrencyCodes` with `organizationId` = the caller's current organization. ⛔ No environment-wide form, no `organizationId` in the body.
- [ ] Preview unless `apply: true`; the response is the same report the CLI prints (`--json` shape).
- [ ] Gate: `setup.write` in the caller's current organization (the ruling's recommendation; the maintainer named none, `manage_metadata` is the alternative). Behind the maintenance-door switch, as `_migrate-stored` is.
- [ ] SDK client method, route-ledger row, error codes from the existing registry only (no new wire code).
- [ ] The 409 `destructive_change` remedy text names this door beside the CLI command.
- [ ] Tests: two organizations; caller sees and writes only its own; missing capability refused; maintenance switch off refused; preview writes nothing.
- [ ] Docs: the endpoint beside the CLI command; note that a Setup button is a separate `domain:ui` card, held until the ui lane resumes.

Lane: server · Size: M · Model: opus, effort high · Review: default. `Clause-②: yes (widening: new route, new SDK method)` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Out of scope: the Setup/Studio button (`domain:ui`, ui lane is off); `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`.

Dedupe: #8345 thread; ruling 6670707546; no open card carries a REST form of this backfill.
